Community group plans Mineral Wells meeting from July 19 to June 30, 2027
The Rotary Club of Mineral Wells will host its Weekly Meeting in Mineral Wells, beginning July 19 and continuing through June 30, 2027.
Friday, Sept 25
By K. C. Mercado
The Rotary Club of Mineral Wells Weekly Meeting, organized by a local community group, is set to take place in Mineral Wells from July 19 through June 30, 2027.
Meetings are scheduled at the Rotary Club of Mineral Wells location, with a start time of 12 p.m.
Community members interested in attending are encouraged to participate and engage in local discussions.
